description: This file defines a generic load generator class for distributed system testing, along with a report structure to record load test metrics. It manages concurrent requests, tracks performance, and generates reports, primarily for testing distributed or networked applications.

classes.name: LoadGeneratorReport
classes.description: A structure to hold the statistics and metrics of the load test, including request counts, failures, total duration, and a method for string representation.

classes.name: ConcurrentLoadGenerator`1
classes.description: A generic class that manages concurrent load generation by spawning multiple worker tasks to issue requests, collect performance metrics, and generate summaries.

methods.name: Warmup
methods.description: Performs an initial warmup run to initialize system state and discard warmup measurements.

methods.name: ResetBetweenRuns
methods.description: Resets internal channels for a new load test run.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the load test, managing worker tasks, collecting blocks of metrics, and generating a final report.

methods.name: BuildReport
methods.description: Aggregates metrics from collected blocks into a summary load report.

methods.name: RunWorker
methods.description: Executes an individual worker task that performs requests repeatedly until the specified number of blocks is processed.
